Title: Vågen House, Bergen
Notes: Mon 7 to Thu 10 Jun, a flat behind Bryggen

Title: Overnight ferry
Notes: Bergen to Hirtshals, cabin for two

Title: Hire car
Notes: Collected at Hirtshals, dropped in Aarhus

Title: Flights
Notes: Edinburgh out, Schiphol home

Title: Edinburgh to Bergen
Notes: Direct flight, about two hours in the air.

Title: Bergen
Notes: Three nights at Vågen House, a flat behind Bryggen. Tue 8 Jun is free: Bryggen, the fish market and the Fløibanen. Check-in from 16:00. Booked in this example.

Title: Bryggen and the Fløibanen
Notes: No transfer. Fish market, wharf and the funicular.

Title: Bergen to Flåm
Notes: Bergen to Myrdal, then the Flåm railway down to the fjord.

Title: Flåm
Notes: Train from Bergen via Myrdal, about two and a half hours. One night at the Fjord Room, by the station. The steep Flåm railway is the point of the day.

Title: Flåm to Bergen
Notes: Back up the valley in time for the evening ferry.

Title: Bergen to Hirtshals
Notes: Overnight ferry, cabin for two.

Title: Hirtshals
Notes: Overnight ferry from Bergen arrives about 08:00. Collect the hire car at the terminal. The cabin is booked in this example. The car is dropped in Aarhus the next afternoon.

Title: Hirtshals to Skagen
Notes: About 40 minutes north once the car is collected.

Title: Skagen
Notes: Walk out to where the two seas meet, then lunch, then turn south.

Title: Skagen to Aalborg
Notes: About an hour and a quarter south, after lunch.

Title: Aalborg
Notes: One night on the quayside. A short drive from Skagen.

Title: Aalborg to Aarhus
Notes: About an hour and a quarter. Drop the car at Aarhus station by mid-afternoon.

Title: Aarhus
Notes: Three nights at Latiner Rooms. Drop the car by the station on Saturday afternoon. Sun 13 Jun: ARoS and the old town. Mon 14 Jun is deliberately empty. Booked in this example.

Title: Drop the car
Notes: Back at Aarhus station by mid-afternoon. The rest of the stay is on foot.

Title: ARoS and the old town
Notes: One museum, then the lanes. Moesgaard stays optional.

Title: Aarhus loop via Skanderborg
Notes: Optional loop south of the city. The faint line is the ride back to Aarhus, not a reverse of each hop. South of Aarhus Faint line back to the base

Title: Nothing planned
Notes: Latin Quarter, coffee, an early night.

Title: Aarhus to Copenhagen
Notes: About three hours, no changes worth planning around.

Title: Copenhagen
Notes: Two nights in a Nyhavn attic flat. Wed 16 Jun: Nyhavn and a canal tour. Nothing else is booked.

Title: Nyhavn and a canal tour
Notes: Louisiana stays optional, up the coast.

Title: Copenhagen to Amsterdam
Notes: Leave about 07:30, change at Hamburg for lunch, Amsterdam by early evening. The long travel day of the trip, on purpose.

Title: Hamburg
Notes: Change trains and eat lunch near the station. Not an overnight.

Title: Amsterdam
Notes: Three nights at Canal House on the Prinsengracht. Fri 18 Jun: anniversary supper, booked. Sat 19 Jun: the Jordaan, slowly. The supper is the one fixed plan in the city.

Title: Canals, then supper
Notes: The anniversary table is the only booking in the city.

Title: Stay in the neighbourhood
Notes: Haarlem is there if the day feels too still.

Title: Amsterdam to Schiphol
Notes: A short train to the airport for the 18:40 departure.

Title: Amsterdam to Edinburgh
Notes: Direct flight. The clock goes back an hour on landing.

Title: Copenhagen to Louisiana
Notes: About 45 minutes up the coast. Not in the plan. Up the coast from Copenhagen Faint line back to the base

Title: Amsterdam to Haarlem
Notes: About 15 minutes. Not in the plan. West of Amsterdam Faint line back to the base

Title: Moesgaard
Notes: A museum south of the city. Not in the plan. South of Aarhus

Title: Skanderborg
Notes: A pause on the optional loop south of Aarhus. Not in the plan. On the way to Moesgaard
